description: This file defines the SceneSet class, which implements a plugin interface for managing application scenes within the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for configuration and notification handling, and declares methods for initialization, deinitialization, and handling app lifecycle state changes.

classes.name: SceneSet
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing scene management and app lifecycle monitoring.

classes.name: SceneSet::Configuration
classes.description: Nested class for plugin configuration, holding the reference application name.

classes.name: SceneSet::NotificationHandler
classes.description: Nested class implementing app lifecycle notifications and forwarding them to the parent SceneSet.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin before shutdown.

methods.name: OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in application lifecycle state notifications.

methods.name: MonitorReferenceAppCrash
methods.description: Monitors the reference application's crash status.

methods.name: RestartReferenceApp
methods.description: Restarts the reference application if needed.
